access_limits.backup: Unknown until the owner supplies and authorizes the destination and its access limits.
access_limits.primary_evidence: Unknown until the owner-authorized local configuration is created.
access_limits.project: Unknown until the local project root and selected-reviewer access are configured.

instructions: Copy this template to config/storage.local.json only when configuring authorized storage; keep that file private.
Supply absolute paths for project and primary_evidence. The default primary store may be inside project.
Leave backup unset until the owner supplies an authorized absolute destination and describes its failure domain.

Use a distinct failure domain for drive-loss protection. An explicitly owner-selected separate directory on the same volume may be configured with owner_selected_same_volume=true and a documented rationale; it protects separate copies, not loss of that volume.
The backup root must not overlap project or primary_evidence, and references must not escape their configured root.
An unset or unreachable backup blocks affected original analysis and research-session completion, while unrelated implementation may continue.
A path in this file does not grant access, provision storage, connect an account, or confirm a backup.
